semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in thermoplastic semi-finished products and materials specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing applications.
summary: Roechling Industrial Products (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. produces a wide range of high-performance thermoplastic materials used in the semiconductor industry, including components for front-end and back-end test socket applications. Their products are essential for the efficient manufacture of reliable IC chips and include cleanroom and ESD materials.
capabilities: Production of thermoplastic semi-finished products including PP, PVDF, PEEK, POM, UHMW-PE
Manufacturing of low particle generation materials for bearing and wear applications
Development of additively manufactured components for prototypes and production
Supply of cleanroom quality machined components

regional_presence.China: The company operates a wholly-owned subsidiary in Suzhou, focusing on the production and sales of thermoplastic materials.
